response.evidence: The revised executive summary and M1 milestone proposal comprehensively resolve all prior research findings. The report establishes a clear, feasible offline-first architecture utilizing a bundled, pinned MIT-licensed Open Filament Database (OFD) snapshot without attempting network access evasion or unvalidated live refreshes. NTAG215 capacity budgeting is mathematically verified (146 bytes base / 217 bytes extended NDEF vs 504 bytes tag user memory), diameter unit handling explicitly enforces decimal millimeters (rejecting uncorrected legacy integer inputs), unknown OpenSpool schema versions/fields are safely handled as read-only/preserved, and physical device testing is correctly categorized as an M1 implementation acceptance gate rather than a claimed research accomplishment. The document provides a sound, evidence-backed foundation for the owner's decision on M1 authorization.
